title: Primes below the Lovász prime
statement: For each natural number $n$, let the Lovász prime be the least prime strictly greater than $2^{\lceil\log_2(2n)\rceil}+1$. If a natural number $q$ satisfies $2^{\lceil\log_2(2n)\rceil}<q$ and $q$ is less than the Lovász prime, then $q$ is not prime.
hypotheses_covered: $q$ is less than the Lovász prime for $n$
